annotations.title: Get install steps for a mail app

description: Get the steps to add an email signature in a mail app or tool, from Signatoro's install guides, with the link to the full guide. Pass the app as client, e.g. "gmail", "outlook-new", "outlook-classic", "apple-mail", "ios-mail", "zoho-mail", "thunderbird". An unknown client answers with the list of guides there are.

client.description: The mail app or tool, e.g. "gmail" or "apple-mail".
